about.title: About StarBuddy
about.subtitle: Where the data comes from, which services we use, and who tests it
about.whatBody: StarBuddy is a free, self-hosted tool for a Star Citizen community: members record the materials, items and blueprints they hold, the site works out what the org can craft with what is on hand, and a desktop client reads the game log and — on your own machine — parts of the game screen to save typing. It is an unofficial fan project by United Danes, licensed AGPL-3.0.
about.sourcesBody: Game data is never translated or edited by us — it is shown as the source publishes it. Each service is polled on a schedule (daily for reference data, every minute for the RSI status) and cached on this server; your browser only talks to this server.

wikiApi.usedFor: Blueprints and their recipes, crafted items with lore, images and stats, commodity list and rarity, and the material types you can enter.
wikiApi.how: Public JSON API (v2 blueprints, items, commodities), synced daily; item lore and stats are fetched the first time a blueprint is opened and cached.

wikiPages.usedFor: Per-material quality bands (the Ore quality tables).
wikiPages.how: MediaWiki API, the page's wikitext is parsed daily.

scTradeTools.usedFor: Stations, cities and outposts you can store things at.

rsiStatus.usedFor: Maintenance and outage alerts — the banner here, the overlay window and the Discord ping.
rsiStatus.how: The status site's public JSON feed, polled every minute; links go to the original notice.

signatures.usedFor: What a scan signature means: mineral, cluster size, composition, resistance.
signatures.how: A table compiled from game-file extractions and community references (dumpers_repo, starvein / SC_Signature_Scanner, sc-ore-scanner — MIT), cross-checked and kept in our repository; the client carries a copy.

ocrs.usedFor: Reading numbers and names off the game screen (scan signature, fabricator).
ocrs.how: Open-source OCR models (≈15 MB) downloaded once to the desktop client; all recognition runs on your machine, no screenshot leaves it.

discord.usedFor: Signing in, knowing who is in the org, and posting alerts.
discord.how: Discord login (OAuth) and a bot in the community server; we store your Discord id, name and avatar only.

about.yourDataBody:
Inventories, blueprints, refinery orders and crafts are yours: entered by hand, imported from CSV, or picked up from your Game.log by the desktop client. They are shared only within the orgs you are a member of, according to each stack's visibility.
Screenshots members contribute for OCR verification are kept in the project repository with their consent and used for nothing else.
about.testersBody: Members who run the dev builds, break things on purpose and tell us what happened — thank you.
about.creditsBody:
A United Danes community project, built by DK-Raven with Claude (Anthropic). Design and code are on GitHub under AGPL-3.0; the Star Citizen Wiki, SC Trade Tools, ocrs and the signature-table authors make the data side possible.
Star Citizen®, Roberts Space Industries® and Cloud Imperium® are registered trademarks of Cloud Imperium Rights LLC. This is an unofficial fan site.

training.title: Scan training
training.subtitle: Contribute screenshots that teach StarBuddy to read in-game panels

help.title: What makes a useful screenshot
help.body: Off-angle, awkward and partly blocked captures are worth more than clean head-on ones — they are what real use looks like. Send the whole frame, straight from the game, no cropping and no HUD mods. Avoid other players' names where you can.

training.tooBig: That file is larger than {{limit}} MB. Send the original PNG or JPEG straight from the game.
training.submitted: Thank you — your screenshot is in the review queue.
training.submitBlocked: Mark all four corners and pick the screen and HUD colour first.
training.noneYet: You have not contributed any screenshots yet.
training.alreadyExported: Included in an earlier dataset download.

picker.sampleHint: Click the brightest part of the HUD — a lit border, a heading, a number.

fields.sampleColour: Sample HUD colour from the screenshot
